href.description:
URL of the image to render as the base map.
Must be same-origin (or CORS-enabled) so it can be reprojected on a canvas.

imageBounds.description: Geographic extent the source image covers, as [[west, south], [east, north]]. The image is assumed to be in the equirectangular (plate carrée) projection. If west is greater than east, the range wraps across the antimeridian.

dataUrl.name: dataUrl
dataUrl.description: The reprojected raster as a data URL, or null when it could not be produced.
